rationale: The single most emphasized ground-truth concern — the docs build failure caused by the recipes.vllm.ai link (two CHANGES_REQUESTED reviews plus a top comment plus an inline comment naming the exact fix) — is caught by X (as a nit, correctly proposing the same canonical GitHub URL fix) but entirely missed by Y. Both independently catch the orphaned <sup>H3</sup> footnote and the wrong reference-count bullet, which cross-validates those findings as real for both. X's additional findings (MODEL/FL2VA partition scoping, aiter silent fallback, VAE GroupNorm scope, gfx950 reproducibility) are well-grounded with specific code citations, whereas Y pads its list with redundant restatements of the same reference-count issue and includes at least one likely-incorrect claim (that TorchCodec is unused in the code, which conflicts with the later 'prebuilt image updated with correct torchcodec' resolution). Both are reasonably actionable with concrete file/line fixes, but X's prioritized structure and closer alignment with the real blocking issue give it the edge.
